This is a prototype for testing. It is not ready for audiences yet.

To install it, open this page on an Android phone (Android 8 or newer), download the `.apk` file
under Assets, and open it. Android asks once whether to allow installs from your browser. To
check the download, compare its SHA-256 with the `.sha256` file.

To try it with the Elephants Dream demo, follow "Try it" in the
[README](https://github.com/cinema-access-lab/In-Kino#try-it). Please report problems and
the phone model you used under Issues.
